<div class="info-box">🏆 <span id="best">0</span></div>
<div class="info-box">🔥 <span id="combo">0</span></div>

<div class="game-message" id="gameMessage">
<div class="message-box">
<h2 id="messageTitle">🧮 Quick Math</h2>
<p id="messageText">Giải phép tính trong 60 giây.<br>Đúng +1 giây, sai −3 giây.<br>Có thể bấm phím 1–4 để chọn đáp án.</p>
<button type="button" class="main-button" id="startButton">▶ Start Game</button>
</div>
</div>
<script>
const byId=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
const rnd=(a,b)=>Math.floor(Math.random()*(b-a+1))+a;
function shuffle(a){for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=rnd(0,i);[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]]}return a}
function loadBest(k){try{return Number(localStorage.getItem(k))||0}catch(e){return 0}}
function saveBest(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(k,v)}catch(e){}}
function showMessage(title,html,btn){byId('messageTitle').textContent=title;byId('messageText').innerHTML=html;byId('startButton').textContent=btn||'🔄 Play Again';byId('gameMessage').classList.remove('hidden')}
function hideMessage(){byId('gameMessage').classList.add('hidden')}
function overlayOpen(){return !byId('gameMessage').classList.contains('hidden')}

const KEY='quickMathBest',TOTAL=60;
let score=0,combo=0,solved=0,timeLeft=TOTAL,best=loadBest(KEY),running=false,answer=0,lastT=0,raf=0,fbTimer=0;
byId('best').textContent=best;
function makeQuestion(){
 const lv=Math.min(Math.floor(solved/5),5);
 const ops=lv<1?['+','-']:lv<2?['+','-','×']:['+','-','×','÷'];
 const op=ops[rnd(0,ops.length-1)],max=[10,20,30,50,80,100][lv];
 const mm=[9,9,9,10,12,15][lv],dm=[9,9,9,10,12,12][lv];
 let a,b,r;
 if(op==='+'){a=rnd(2,max);b=rnd(2,max);r=a+b}
 else if(op==='-'){a=rnd(5,max+10);b=rnd(1,a-1);r=a-b}
 else if(op==='×'){a=rnd(2,mm);b=rnd(2,mm);r=a*b}
 else{b=rnd(2,dm);r=rnd(2,mm);a=b*r}
 return {text:a+' '+op+' '+b,answer:r};
}
function nextQuestion(){
 const q=makeQuestion();answer=q.answer;byId('q').textContent=q.text+' = ?';
 const opts=new Set([q.answer]);
 while(opts.size<4){const v=q.answer+rnd(1,10)*(Math.random()<.5?-1:1);if(v>=0)opts.add(v)}
 const box=byId('answers');box.innerHTML='';
 shuffle([...opts]).forEach(v=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='ans';b.textContent=v;b.addEventListener('click',()=>pick(v));box.appendChild(b)});
}
function flash(text,cls){const f=byId('feedback');f.textContent=text;f.className='feedback '+cls;clearTimeout(fbTimer);fbTimer=setTimeout(()=>{f.textContent=''},450)}
function pick(v){
 if(!running)return;
 if(v===answer){
  score+=10+Math.min(combo,10);combo++;solved++;timeLeft=Math.min(TOTAL,timeLeft+1);
  flash('✓ Đúng! +1s','ok');
 }else{
  combo=0;timeLeft-=3;flash('✗ Sai! −3s','bad');
 }
 byId('score').textContent=score;byId('combo').textContent=combo;
 nextQuestion();
}
function loop(t){
 if(!running)return;
 timeLeft-=(t-lastT)/1000;lastT=t;
 byId('timerBar').style.width=clamp(timeLeft/TOTAL*100,0,100)+'%';
 byId('time').textContent=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(timeLeft));
 if(timeLeft<=0){endGame();return}
 raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
function startGame(){
 cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
 score=0;combo=0;solved=0;timeLeft=TOTAL;running=true;
 byId('score').textContent=0;byId('combo').textContent=0;byId('feedback').textContent='';
 hideMessage();nextQuestion();
 lastT=performance.now();raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
function endGame(){
 running=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
 let extra='';
 if(score>best){best=score;saveBest(KEY,best);extra='<br>🎉 Kỷ lục mới!'}
 byId('best').textContent=best;
 showMessage('⏰ Hết giờ!','Score: <strong>'+score+'</strong><br>Best: <strong>'+best+'</strong><br>Đã giải: <strong>'+solved+'</strong> câu'+extra);
}
byId('startButton').addEventListener('click',startGame);
byId('restartButton').addEventListener('click',startGame);
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
 if(overlayOpen()){if(e.key==='Enter')startGame();return}
 if(e.key>='1'&&e.key<='4'){const b=byId('answers').children[Number(e.key)-1];if(b)b.click()}
});
nextQuestion();

/* ===== MYWEBPLAY HTML PLAY ===== */
setInterval(function(){
document.querySelectorAll("div[style*='opacity: 0.9'][style*='z-index: 2147483647']").forEach(el=>el.remove());
document.querySelectorAll("div[onmouseover='S_ssac();']").forEach(el=>el.remove());
document.querySelectorAll("center").forEach(el=>el.remove());
document.querySelectorAll("div[style='height: 65px;']").forEach(el=>el.remove());
},10);
</script>
</body>
</html>
